Scenario fixture: server-side-image-map-absent (no server-side image maps)

Each target <img> has a stable id of the form ssim_case_NN. Presence of ismap is itself the violation — there is no partial-pass case.

A. Invalid

01 — FAIL: img with ismap, inside a link

B. Valid / not applicable (skipped, not counted)

02 — NEUTRAL: ordinary image, no ismap attribute
03 — NEUTRAL: client-side image map (usemap), not flagged by this rule

End of fixture.
